scope: Full GUI capability parity gates over the frozen desktop baseline; partial native tests and source structure do not establish these gates

imageDifferential.reason: Native RGBA, SVG, pen, collision, bubble and font fixtures pass, but no explicitly authorized GUI/browser oracle has been run. Paper geometry, missing glyphs, antialiasing and monitor overlay remain incomplete.

audioDifferential.reason: Frozen GUI graph is exercised on the native DSP, PCM/WAV and encoder audio samples are tested; independent browser waveforms, full decode surface and whole-project audio scheduling are not accepted.

platforms.reason: Only macOS arm64 / Node24.18.0 was executed. No Windows/Linux install+runtime fixture or packaged-player platform playback acceptance exists. GUI applications were not launched.

performance.reason: Bounded recording memory pressure is measured, but startup/load/frame-step comparisons against the frozen desktop baseline are not complete.

permissions.reason: Exact per-command grants, fail-closed network and three independent security repair probes pass; complete frozen extension/security callback behavior and an OS-confined custom extension execution environment are still incomplete. Capability checks are not an OS sandbox.

devices.reason: Recorded media/gamepad/cloud/keyboard/mouse input and frozen BLE/BT message parsers are tested. Six hardware families, real HID/rumble and physical connection/output tests are not accepted. D7 permits prerecorded camera/microphone replacements only.
